verdict.rationale: Kick's own Platform API reference embeds per-operation OpenAPI 3.0.2 specs and renders an interactive explorer with a "Test it" runner for each operation. That covers the story's interactive, runnable reference. However, the API is not publicly available and is enabled per organization, so running real calls needs an org token. No single downloadable OpenAPI spec exists either; all probed spec paths returned 404. Missing for 10: public access to run the examples, a consolidated downloadable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the runner works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API reference renders GitBook's OpenAPI explorer with a "Test it" runner per operation
The Platform API is not yet publicly available. Access is enabled per organization by the Kick team.
